findings.reason: this is the sole control on the branch that carries 1,643 of the 1,649 excluded names, so a false negative there removes the census's main guard and sends the node looking for a replacement witness; the fix is one word ("one incoming `REFINED_FROM` edge").
findings.text: the incoming-`REFINED_FROM` control reads "`x_direction_unit_vector_of_sensor` covers the incoming `REFINED_FROM` branch: it has one incoming edge and no successor edge", but the node has 14 incoming edges (13 `FOR_STANDARD_NAME` from `LLMCost` nodes plus exactly 1 `REFINED_FROM`); a verifier who counts incoming edges as the sentence tells them to gets 14 and reports the only control on that branch as failed
